component.name: SEOWebChecker
component.summary: Lightweight website SEO audit tool and CLI

ul.li: Complete on-page technical SEO validation (title, description, canonicals, robots, meta tags)
Heading structure (H1-H6) and semantic content hierarchy analysis
Image accessibility and ALT attribute checks
Link integrity and internal vs external link audits
Formatted console, Markdown, and JSON reporting

description.p: Production release with multi-format reports and Core Web Vitals audit engine.
